title: VR-FraudNet Stage 2 structured rationale
description: Machine-checkable rationale object emitted by the schema-constrained rationale language model (manuscript Section 4.3.2). Every field in this schema is checkable by the Stage 3 deterministic verifier; unrestricted free-form fields are deliberately absent.

verdict.description: Proposed verdict. Manuscript S4.3.2 restricts this to three values.

rationale_probability.description: Rationale-side fraud probability. Treated as an UNVERIFIED language-model output: it is passed to the Stage 4 mixer only when the Stage 3 verifier accepts the complete rationale (manuscript S4.3.2, S4.5).

claims.description: Structured claims. Manuscript S4.3.2 permits at most eight claims per transaction.

evidence_references.description: Identifiers of the evidence entries this rationale relies on. Every claim's evidence_id must appear here, and every id must exist in the transaction's evidence dictionary.

type.description: One of the five claim primitives of manuscript S4.3.2.

field.description: Referenced transaction field or entity identifier.

operator.description: Comparison operator or relation. The admissible operator set depends on the claim type; the Stage 3 verifier enforces that dependency (see verifier/rules/claim_primitives.yaml).

value.description: Asserted value. Numbers for numeric and temporal claims, strings for entity matches, arrays for set membership, objects for graph paths.

evidence_id.description: Identifier of the evidence entry supporting this claim. Must resolve inside the current transaction's evidence dictionary; a retrieved training example can never be cited (manuscript S4.3.4).
